Need to search first.I don't have any notes on Jeremiah 9 for you yet. None of my research worked, so I have nothing from the approved sites that I can report.

My first attempt was to open the commentary pages directly: Enduring Word, Precept Austin, the Bible Hub pages for Ellicott, Gill and the Pulpit Commentary, and the NET Bible notes. The tool refused every one, because it only opens pages that have first come up in a search. When I then ran the searches (one for the chapter as a whole, plus verses 1, 23–24 and 25–26), the tool told me I had reached my limit for this turn. No results came back.

Your rules say to report only what the pages I read actually say. Since I read none, I've written nothing rather than fill the gaps from memory, and I have no URLs to give.

To get the notes, ask me again in a new message. I'll search first and then read the pages that come up:
- **Traditional reading, verse by verse:** Enduring Word, the Gill, Ellicott and Pulpit commentaries on Bible Hub or StudyLight, and Precept Austin.
- **Where Protestant traditions differ:** probably verses 23–24 (boasting only in knowing God) and 25–26 (circumcised in body but not in heart). I'd check the Reformed, Baptist, Wesleyan, Lutheran and Pentecostal sites on your list.
- **Other views:** the NET Bible notes, plus New Advent, Catholic.com and OCA. For verse 1 I'd also look at how the "weeping prophet" is treated.

If the limit is likely to hit again, you could have me take the chapter in parts, such as verses 1–9, 10–22 and 23–26.
